plurals.name: health_connect_import_message
plurals.item: Health Connect contains %d sleep previously written by Plees Tracker that is not in this installation. Import it, keep it only in Health Connect, or delete all Plees Tracker sleep data from Health Connect before synchronizing local sleeps? If Health Connect Scheduled export is configured, keeping it there can provide an additional recovery source.
